templates.name: Daily QA template – Proton gantry (TG-224)
templates.setup:
Daily QA protocol, in accordance with TG-224

Last updated August, 2026.

checks.name: Other – Daily QA Setup
checks.description:
Template 0.01. Patient Name:  QA G2 PBS

Is loading bar shifted to Gantry 270. 
Is RS taken off?
Is Snout Retracted?
Is Electrometer setup, turn on voltage, set to -300V. 
Compensate and Run Background.

Begin Imaging protocol: 
Index to Sphinx to H3. 
Validate PPC05 is correct number.
Set DCEU to at least 800.

checks.name: Energy [100 MeV] – Distal Depth
checks.description:
Template 3.01. Patient Name:  QA G2 PBS

Document MUs
Document Charge
Run Sphinx Analysis

Completing TG-224: 

Imaging: 
- X-ray and proton beam isocenter coincidence < 1mm (Spot)

Dosimetry: 
- Output < 3% for different energies on different days with one consistent field.  (Output)
- Distal Depth: 1mm at distal 90% depth dose. (Energy)
- Spot position: 2mm/1mm absolute/relative. (Spot)
